optimizedContext.value:
# Guide Domain Model

Pure domain types for catalog, outline, section extract, search. Addressable identity `collection:topic`.

## Rules

### GuideTopic
- `collection`: canonical group id (`sdk`, `core`, `code-graph`, `skills`, `schemas`).
- `topic`: id within collection. Hand-written: source path relative to collection root, no extension, lowercased, keep `/` (`index`, `ports`, `examples/implementing-a-port`). Generated: collection-relative path assigned by bundler.
- `title`, `description`: frontmatter strings.
- `order`: numeric presentation idx (`sidebar_position`).
- `content`: markdown body, YAML frontmatter stripped.
- `lineCount`: lines in `content`. `byteLength`: byte size of `content`.
- `outline`: `GuideSection[]`.
- Identity MUST be `collection:topic`. `:` reserved delimiter; MUST NOT appear in `collection` or `topic`. `/` MAY appear in `topic`.

### GuideSection
- `index`: 1-indexed position in outline.
- `heading`: text, no leading `#`.
- `level`: heading depth (`1` = `#`, `2` = `##`, `3` = `###`).
- `startLine` / `endLine`: 1-indexed inclusive.
- `lines`: `endLine - startLine + 1`.
- `startOffset` / `endOffset`: 0-indexed char offsets into parent `content`.
- `content?`: optional / on-demand; heading line through `endLine`.
- `startOffset` + `endOffset` MUST live in generated catalog so section text extracts without re-parse.

### GuideSummary
- `collection`, `topic`, `title`, `description`, `order`, `lineCount`, `byteLength`.
- Lean catalog row: no `content`, no `outline`.
- Listings MAY span collections; caller MUST bound returned volume.
- Order per collection only: ascending `order`, ties locale-sensitive alphabetical `topic`. `order` need not be unique. No cross-collection order.

### GuideOutline
- `collection`, `topic`, `file`, `lines`, `bytes`, `sections: GuideSection[]`.
- `file`: real source path relative to collection root. MUST NOT synthesize from `topic`.
- Hand-written: relative `.md` path (`ports.md`, `examples/implementing-a-port.md`).
- Generated API topic: relative path of declaration source (TypeScript file, not Markdown).

### GuideSearchHit
- `collection`, `topic`, `file`, `section` (heading), `sectionIndex`, `level`, `startLine`, `endLine`.
- `score`, `snippet` (1-indexed line numbers), `readCommand`.
- `file`: same real-path rule as `GuideOutline.file`.
- `readCommand` uses section index; command name derived from collection. Example: `specd guide-sdk sdk:classes/ArtifactDag --section 3`. `sdk` hit MUST emit `specd guide-sdk`, never `specd guide`.
- `level`, `startLine`, `endLine` MUST be indexed document fields so section-scoped retrieval needs no re-parse.

## Constraints

- Pure TypeScript types or immutable classes; no runtime dependencies.
- All line numbers 1-indexed positive integers.
